probe: Reward V5 — cleanup and confirmation pass
status: FROZEN — contract declared before launch; constants must NOT change after launch
scope: V5 does exactly two things: budget the now-measured mine-tag reward, and apply the repaired Condition D. Nothing else in V4 is touched. This is a confirmation pass, not further reward archaeology.

sparse_mine_tag_points.derivation: Measured in V4 at 0.129-0.182 events/episode. At +100 that is +0.13-0.18 reward units/episode against a terminal of 0.87-0.99 — roughly 15-20% of the objective, from a direct repeatable payoff. Set to zero for the same reason ordinary tags were: the game consequence should make mine tags useful. If mine tagging genuinely helps win, PPO can learn that through outcome.

REWARD_CHANNEL_CLASSIFICATION.rule: A rising terminal or capture reward while the policy is winning must NEVER by itself trigger the new-attractor condition. Only farmable shaping families can.
REWARD_CHANNEL_CLASSIFICATION.correction_note: mine_tag is classified TACTICAL from V5 onward; in V4 it sat outside the frozen tactical bucket because it was unresolved at freeze time (see artifacts/reward_v4/V4_ACCOUNTING_LIMITATION.json)

B_COMPETENCE.note: threshold deliberately kept at >=2/3 rather than raised to 3/3 after seeing V4 produce 3/3; raising a bar after observing a favourable result is exactly the move this protocol forbids

D_NO_SUSTAINED_FARMABLE_ATTRACTOR.why_repaired: V4's condition D fired on microscopic panel drift (pickups 44.3->40.0, offensive_commitment 0.226->0.218) while TRAINING SUCCESS ROSE in all three seeds. It had no magnitude threshold and no persistence requirement on a 9-episode panel, so any dip made every rising channel suspicious -- including the objective itself.
triggers_only_if_ALL_FOUR_hold: 1. a task metric deteriorates by at least its preregistered meaningful amount
2. that deterioration is sustained across at least 2 consecutive panels
3. a FARMABLE shaping family increases in magnitude over the same interval
4. overall success/objective performance does not improve enough to contradict it
D_NO_SUSTAINED_FARMABLE_ATTRACTOR.contradiction_rule: If training success improves by >= 0.10 over the run, condition 4 is not satisfied and the attractor condition does NOT trigger.

E_REWARD_BUDGET.report_also: progress shaping (grab, carry_home) share -- reported, not gated, since a pickup is genuine progress toward the objective

CLASSIFICATION.PASS: A and B and C and D and E all pass
CLASSIFICATION.MIXED: competence passes BUT alignment/budget/attractor condition fails
CLASSIFICATION.FAIL: alive requirement or competence requirement fails

DO_NOT_STOP_FOR: one seed looking weak at 100k or 150k
if_v5_passes: STOP reward tuning. Proceed to fresh long G0-V5 policies, require >=2 competent independent seeds, then weakness discovery, C1 confirmation on fresh held-out seeds, O1, complementarity, first latent birth.
